connector.name: MCP Server by bitcompare
connector.registryDescription: Crypto yield data for AI agents: lending, savings, staking, borrowing & stablecoin rates. 18 tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.bitcompare.net over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bitcompare account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

env.name: BITCOMPARE_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer API key from https://pro.bitcompare.net/dashboard/keys. Format: ck_live_*. Requires a Pro or Enterprise plan for MCP access.
